dr_flac.h — vendored FLAC decoder for the zcsr music module
============================================================

Source provenance
-----------------
- Original project: dr_flac 0.13.4 by David Reid (mackron),
  https://github.com/mackron/dr_libs
- Extraction path: the dr_flac header and implementation blocks were taken
  from the copy of dr_flac namespaced inside miniaudio 1.73
  (https://github.com/mackron/miniaudio), shipped locally under
  build/_vendor_tmp/miniaudio-1.73/ during development.
- All `ma_dr_flac_*` / `MA_DR_FLAC_*` identifiers were renamed to the
  `drflac_*` / `DR_FLAC_*` prefix; the miniaudio allocation-callback and
  result types are re-declared as local shims at the top of dr_flac.h.
- Changes from upstream: implementation block guarded by
  `#if defined(DR_FLAC_IMPLEMENTATION)`; no other decoder logic was edited.
